# Real voices for the hands-free tests

Six short clips of real people, each saying a participant tag ("C three P
two", "F C six seven P two"), mixed at 10 dB with site noise (generator hum
or hammer bursts), 16 kHz mono.

| File | Accent | Said |
| --- | --- | --- |
| hammer_001.wav | European | And I am participant C thirteen P two |
| gen_034.wav | Irish English | Hi, I'm participant number F C six seven P two |
| hammer_040.wav | Mainstream US English | Hello, and my number is C three P two |
| gen_050.wav | Nigerian English | Yeah, my participant number is, um, F C nineteen P two |
| hammer_063.wav | Jamaican English | Hey, I'm participant F C five seven P two |
| gen_067.wav | Vietnamese | Hi, my participant number is F C six seven P two |

Source: the Edinburgh International Accents of English Corpus (EdAcc),
Sanabria et al., 2023, https://groups.inf.ed.ac.uk/edacc/ (Hugging Face:
`edinburghcstr/edacc`), licensed CC BY-SA 4.0
(https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). These clips are
adapted (cut, resampled, mixed with noise) and are shared under the same
license.
